system.description: The raksha's control over his bestial form is such that he can reflexively alter it as needed to achieve his goals. If activated in tandem with Assumption of Bestial Visage, the raksha acquires the following innate ability: Innate Power (Cost: 5m; Speed: 5): With but a thought, the raksha can make some minor change to his bestial form sufficient to grant him a +2 internal Wyld bonus. The player must define what sort of change is made to acquire this bonus. He might grow claws to aid in combat. He might acquire prehensile fingers to help with climbing. His eyes might change to those of a cat or hawk to facilitate Awareness rolls. The effect lasts as long as the raksha continues to pursue the same action for which he activated this power, which might be a single dice roll or a months-long pursuit. The raksha need only describe the changes wrought by this power in terms of animal traits in general. The potential traits are not limited to the characteristics of the animal with which he has associated his Assumption of Bestial Visage Charm. Because this power affects only the raksha himself, it does not provoke Glamour Resistance.
